title: Recording: Zoo Gang by Wings | 1973
content:
Studio Two, EMI Studios, London
Producer: Paul McCartney
Engineer: John Leckie

‘Zoo Gang’, the b-side of Wings’ 1974 single ‘Band On The Run’ in the United Kingdom, was completed on 7 May 1973.

The backing track had been taped on 25 April. On this day it was finished with an accordion overdub. ‘Zoo Gang’ was mixed in mono and stereo on 14 May 1973 at AIR Studios.
